features.headline: Four things you usually don't have time for.

0.title: Every channel in one list
0.body: Messages, reviews, and comments from Telegram, VK, and Yandex.Business land in a single stream. No tab-hopping, no forgotten threads.

1.title: A reply in seconds, yours in minutes
1.body: OneVoice knows your hours, menu, and tone. It prepares a draft. You send, tweak, or ask for another try.

2.title: One post — every channel at once
2.body: Write it once — it publishes everywhere, tuned for each platform's format. Schedule it for when your audience is reading.

3.title: Reviews under calm watch
3.body: Every review in plain sight. Low ratings rise to the top. High ones get a thank-you in your tone of voice.
